Metadata.title: 3D Print Cost Calculator
Metadata.description: Work out what a 3D print really costs: filament, electricity, printer wear, hardware like keyrings and magnets, labor and failed prints. Free and open source.

Header.localModeHint: Running on your own machine. Everything is saved to this instance.
Header.guestHint: Your work is saved to this browser. Sign in to keep it on any device.

Home.title: Know what every print really costs
Home.lead: Filament is only part of the bill. Add electricity, printer wear, glue, keyrings, magnets, packaging, your time and the prints that fail, and get a price you can actually sell at.
Home.exampleTitle: Example: a keychain, 12 g of PLA, 48 minutes

counts.filament: Filament by the gram, with waste from purges and supports
counts.machine: Electricity, printer depreciation and maintenance per print hour
counts.extras: Your own list of extras: keyrings, magnets, inserts, glue, paint, boxes
counts.labor: Preparation and post-processing time at your hourly rate
counts.business: Failure rate, overhead, profit margin, VAT and marketplace fees

Library.title: Library
Library.lead: Save your printers, filaments and extras once, then pick them in every calculation.

printers.empty: No printers yet. Add the one you print with to count electricity and wear.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: What you call it, e.g. "P1S in the office".
fields.resaleValueHint: What you expect to sell it for at the end. Leave empty if you'll use it until it dies.
fields.lifetimeHoursHint: Print hours you expect before replacing it. 3,000–8,000 h is common for hobby FDM printers.
fields.powerWattsHint: While printing, including the heated bed. Check a smart plug, or the spec sheet (often 100–350 W).
fields.maintenanceCostPerHourHint: Nozzles, build plates, belts, lubricant, spread per print hour.

filaments.empty: No filaments yet. Add the spools you buy so prints are costed by the gram.

fields.name: Name
fields.spoolWeightGramsHint: Filament only, without the spool. Usually 1000 g.

extras.empty: No extras yet. Add keyrings, magnets, inserts, glue or packaging you put into prints.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.lead: These values fill in every new calculation. You can still change them for a single print.
Settings.notSavedYet: These are starting values. Save to make them yours.

fields.currencyHint: Used for every price you enter. Amounts aren't converted.
fields.electricityPricePerKwhHint: Per kWh, from your bill, taxes included.
fields.laborRatePerHourHint: What an hour of your time is worth. Use 0 to leave labor out.
fields.filamentWastePctHint: Purges, skirts and test lines on top of what the slicer reports.
fields.failureRatePctHint: Share of prints that fail and get reprinted.
fields.overheadPctHint: Rent, software, tools and other running costs, as a share of production cost.
fields.taxRatePctHint: Added to the price the buyer pays. Use 0 if you don't charge it.
fields.marketplaceFeePctHint: Commission taken from the price the buyer pays.

profitModes.MARKUP_hint: A cost of {cost} with {pct} markup sells for {price}.
profitModes.MARGIN_hint: A cost of {cost} with {pct} margin sells for {price}.
